payload.description: Lets your Agents turn spoken audio into text on your own PC, with no cloud and no fee. Transcribes recordings into written text with faster-whisper, running on your own graphics card. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is billed. It needs WSL 2 and an NVIDIA GPU, plus a download of about 1.6 GB. It listens and writes; it does not speak and does not tell speakers apart.
